source.author: verg
source.text: Ergo alte vestiga oculis, et rite repertum carpe manu; namque ipse volens facilisque sequetur, si te fata vocant; aliter non viribus ullis vincere, nec duro poteris convellere ferro.
source.text_original: Ergo alte vestiga oculis, et rite repertum / carpe manu; namque ipse volens facilisque sequetur, / si te fata vocant; aliter non viribus ullis / vincere, nec duro poteris convellere ferro.
source.text_english: Therefore search deeply with your eyes, and when you have duly found it, grasp it with your hand; for it will itself follow of its own will and readily, if the fates call you; otherwise you will be able to overcome it by no force at all, nor tear it away with hard iron.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: cum iam prohibere frementum ora nequit, rex tune aditus et claustra refringit ipse volens placatque data fera murmura porta.
reuse.text_original: cum iam prohibere frementum / ora nequit, rex tune aditus et claustra refringit / ipse volens placatque data fera murmura porta.
reuse.text_english: when he can no longer restrain the roaring mouths, then the king himself breaks open the entrances and barriers and, the gate having been opened, soothes the wild murmurs.
